videos.name: Type Knight official EN trailer
videos.reason: Complete continuous combat passage: enemy approach, word labels, attack/defeat, recovery. Evaluate label footprint and separation from silhouettes, not gameplay timing.

visual_observations.note: Enemy labels are single tiny lines above individual enemies. Horizontal approach changes label positions. Cast begins around f51; targeted enemy flashes and lifts, then falls. No three-word panel or timing bar.
Approach, jump and defeat stages remain at the bottom of a very wide scene. Success clears the targeted label rather than leaving a broad floating frame. Other enemies retain separate tiny labels.
Another complete cast/defeat/recovery and continued enemy approach. Labels occupy a small area above bodies; open landscape above. No evidence for current CLACKBLADE close-duel scale.
Final visible target is defeated then the shot dissolves into empty arena. Label disappears with target. Held/repeated animation frames preserved.
Empty arena, repeated cast waves and recovery. No word panel remains. Trailer hides the normal status HUD; do not infer status motion from this passage.
Arena remains clear before a cut to title card at f647. Cut is retained in reviewed evidence.

videos.status: Complete visual review of selected interval at every retained source frame; no claims outside interval.

videos.name: Furi official Gameplay Trailer
videos.reason: Complete close-duel passage: preparation, contacts, disengagement, energy wave, defense/response, recovery. Evaluate persistent HUD and visible attack space, not frame data/parry windows.

visual_observations.note: Cut from close camera into duel at f2; HP remains at upper screen corners. Enemy prepares then approaches; blue defense effect followed by a green ring around the player. No HUD text placed between fighters.
Contacts, response strikes, disengagement and approach. Health bars remain fixed in corners as camera follows fighters. Attack flashes occupy the centre.
Visible preparation flash before contact, green defense ring and response. Weapon trails occupy substantial space around both silhouettes. Edge status remains legible.

Edited shots retained, including cut near f206, broad projectile/energy effects, dash and camera close-up. Persistent HP remains on screen edges. These are presentation examples, not unedited frame timing evidence.
Defense/contact, response and separation finish before cut at f359 to boss close-up. HUD remains attached to screen edges across camera change. No Space key cue or typing HUD equivalent.
